intended_object: The tautological family of morphisms indexed by the morphisms that satisfy `P` (seen as a set of arrows). It sends each such arrow to its underlying morphism, so that `ofHoms P.homFamily = P`. This reading comes from the docstring and from the reference to `ofHoms_homFamily`.
explanation: This is a technical device for moving from Mathlib's predicate-style `MorphismProperty C` to an indexed family of morphisms `(i : ι) → X i ⟶ Y i`, which is the input format of `MorphismProperty.ofHoms`. The definition is correct: an element `f` of `P.toSet` is an arrow (`Arrow C`) satisfying `P`, and `homFamily f` is `f.1.hom : f.1.left ⟶ f.1.right`. It is also stated at full generality, for any category `C`. Still, it is only a re-indexing that lets `MorphismProperty` and the API for families of morphisms work together, not a notion from the literature. So it has no independent mathematical counterpart to compare it with.
